claims.statement: The semiotic-audit fixture compares two supplied strings.
dependencies: Standard-library-only imports (dataclasses.dataclass and fractions.Fraction) in test_009_adversarial_reality_gate.py with zero code parsers or semantic evaluators.
Single inequality comparison self.signified != self.interpretant in SemioticAudit.is_drift_detected leaving self.signifier unread.
Open obligation: No semantic equivalence decision or downstream code inspection is performed.
claims.limits: Compares raw Python strings signified and interpretant only; ignores signifier, parses no code, and treats semantically equivalent distinct strings as drifted.

claims.statement: The stagnation fixture checks a supplied count, gauge flag, and score.
dependencies: Frozen three-field dataclass StagnationRecord storing caller-supplied consecutive_stagnant_rounds, current_defect_norm, and locked_gauge.
Three-way conjunction consecutive_stagnant_rounds >= threshold_rounds and locked_gauge and current_defect_norm > Fraction(0, 1) in should_trigger_review with default threshold_rounds = 3.
claims.limits: Evaluates caller-supplied summary fields only; computes no graph defect norm, implements no search strategy or escape-rate measurement, and grants no license to modify protected state.

claims.statement: The toy verdict function branches on supplied scores and flags.
dependencies: Four ordered conditional branches in evaluate_terminal_reality_gate over supplied phi1, gamma2, semiotic_clean, and unbudgeted_debt arguments.
Zero arithmetic or solver calls inside evaluate_terminal_reality_gate, echoing phi1 and gamma2 unchanged into TerminalGateVerdict.
Open obligation: Flag provenance and score computation are unverified by this helper.
claims.limits: Pure 36-cell routing helper on supplied Fraction and bool inputs; computes no scores, checks no receipt or flag provenance, and returns PASS_TO_MASTER when phi1 == 0 and gamma2 == 0 with semiotic_clean == True even if unbudgeted_debt == True.

claims.statement: Proposal constructors differ from the designated terminal constructor under the Lean definitions.
